name: kaggle-war-room
description: Multi-role agent workflow for Kaggle competitions: daily monitoring of public notebooks and discussions, notebook review and replication, ensembling, adversarial plan review, and anti-shake-up final submissions.

interface.shortDescription: Run Kaggle competitions with a multi-role agent workflow
interface.longDescription: Scout monitors public notebooks, leaderboard and discussions; Strategist plans experiments and submissions; an independent Critic reviews each plan; Builder reviews, replicates and blends solutions. Includes scripts for snapshot diffing, submission checks, prediction correlation and stagnation detection.
defaultPrompt: Start a new Kaggle competition workspace
Run today's Kaggle update and plan
Help me choose my final submissions
